SELECT o.id,
    c.email
   FROM (shop.orders o
     JOIN shop.customers c ON ((c.id = o.customer_id)));

SELECT kinds.id,
    kinds.name
   FROM features.kinds
  WHERE (kinds.status = 'paid'::features.status);

SELECT kinds.status,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM features.kinds
  GROUP BY kinds.status;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION shop.paid_orders()
 RETURNS SETOF integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ SELECT id FROM shop.orders WHERE status = 'paid' $function$

props.create:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION shop.default_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.status := COALESCE(NEW.status, 'new'); RETURN NEW; END $function$
props.prosrc: BEGIN NEW.status := COALESCE(NEW.status, 'new'); RETURN NEW; END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.floatrange(double precision, double precision)
 RETURNS features.floatrange
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$range_constructor2$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.floatrange(double precision, double precision, text)
 RETURNS features.floatrange
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$range_constructor3$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.floatmultirange()
 RETURNS features.floatmultirange
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$multirange_constructor0$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.floatmultirange(features.floatrange)
 RETURNS features.floatmultirange
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$multirange_constructor1$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.f_cents(m numeric)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$ SELECT (m * 100)::bigint $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION features.f_paid(p_status features.status DEFAULT 'paid'::features.status)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'features'
AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT k.id, k.name FROM features.kinds k WHERE k.status = p_status; END $function$
props.prosrc: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT k.id, k.name FROM features.kinds k WHERE k.status = p_status; END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN NULL; END $function$

props.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_status BEFORE INSERT ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.default_status()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_audit AFTER INSERT ON features.child REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_when BEFORE UPDATE ON features.child FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.parent_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.parent_id)) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER t_child_deferred AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON features.child DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER t_child_checked AFTER DELETE ON features.child FROM features.parent NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()

CREATE RULE r_scratch AS
    ON DELETE TO features.scratch DO INSTEAD NOTHING;
